items.title: Baghdad’s first Jewish museum draws crowds to rediscover Iraq’s Jewish past
items.brief: Dozens of Iraqis visit Baghdad’s first Jewish museum each day to view faded school certificates, handwritten documents and family photographs.

items.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills at least six, including doctor and child, Palestinian officials say
items.brief: An Israeli strike on a hospital in southern Gaza overnight Wednesday killed at least six people, including a doctor and a child, Palestinian officials say.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, CFO Colette Kress to serve as interim leader
items.brief: Jensen Huang, the founder who propelled Nvidia to become one of the world’s most valuable companies, has resigned from his role as chief executive after 33 years.

items.title: Four shot in ‘active’ scene in DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood, police say
items.brief: At least four people were shot in what police are describing as an “active” scene in Washington, DC’s Logan Circle neighborhood, according to authorities.

items.title: Google knows smart glasses have a privacy problem. Here’s how it’s trying to fix it
items.brief: Google’s new smart glasses, like Meta’s, light up to show when they’re recording.
